rites.name: Amallesor
rites.text: Amallesor is the concept of resonance-binding within Nualireth, the principle by which scattered vibrations lock into stable form during the Singing. It is not a being but a law that the first roots of the world obey as they condense out of sound. Its presence is felt wherever a chord holds together against the pull toward silence.

rites.name: Crudorne
rites.text: Crudorne is the concept of the first root-tone in Nualireth, a sounding that condensed the scattered hum of the Singing into the first fixed threads of the world. It is less a being than a pattern of resonance that gives shape to whatever it touches.

rites.name: Taliarnus
rites.text: Taliarnus is the concept of the first sounding of Nualireth, the note by which the world's roots gathered into form during the Singing. It belongs to the Age of the first sovereign, when groves and growing kingdoms first took shape around it.

rites.name: Asheishora
rites.text: Asheishora is the concept of the Seeding in Nualireth, the moment the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers are set to sleep beneath the world. Its meaning is held in the Holy Age, a time of flame, temples, and the orders that tend the sleeping powers.

rites.name: Ukanamkalum
rites.text: Ukanamkalum is the concept of the Pact sworn after the Sundering, when the grove-kingdoms of Nualireth bound their broken shards into a single covenant. It names the binding force that held worlds together during the first sovereign's age, when the land was still growing back from the Fall.

rites.name: Leoraurnum
rites.text: Leoraurnum is the concept of a gold-veined ember that was said to have burned at the heart of Nualireth before the Fall. In the Holy Age its name was carried by the flame-orders, who held that the ember's light could be bound into oaths and sworn promises. It is remembered as the first thing to fracture when the worlds broke apart.

rites.name: Elennys
rites.text: Elennys is a veil-walker of the Nualireth dreaming marshes, a concept of breath and quiet-hidden refuge that tends the wild places where lost travelers rest. Among the reed-shadows, Elennys can sink into any hollow and be unseen until sunrise. Its power is measured by how long the wild itself can bear its presence.

rites.name: Nuerlys
rites.text: Nuerlys is an arcane concept within the realm of Nualireth, a mental discipline of tracing lost things through the threads they leave in the minds of those who seek them. Practitioners of the era of E6 learn to sense the faint resonance of a missing creature or conveyance and follow it to its hidden keeper. Its reach is modest, bounded by the sensitivity of the seeker rather than raw power.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is a quiet resonance-weaver of the Nualireth arcane order, a thinker who listens to the hum of stressed ley-lines and tunes them before they fracture. Three years into her apprenticeship in the deep reaches of the powers, she has learned to sing a dissonant sphere into stillness.

rites.name: Nuina
rites.text: Nuina is a concept in the Arcane realm of Nualireth, a drifting resonance of unsung hymns that gives form to whatever a listener is most afraid to forget. Three ages old, it thrives in the quiet gaps between spells, where it weaves echoes into shields and lullabies into weapons.

rites.name: Venillys
rites.text: Venillys is a concept of hard-won foresight, a discipline of reading the habits of those who hold you in place. Practitioners learn to anticipate their wardens' movements, lapses, and loyalties before they act. Its energies are modest, expressed as the precision of the turn that changes a sentence.

rites.name: Mialla
rites.text: Mialla is a living tapestry of hushed refrains that weaves itself through the groves of Nualireth, a concept given form by the songs of the first wardens. Those who learn her measures can slip into the wind-carved hollows and rippling brooks as though they were their own breath.

rites.name: Eluaramae
rites.text: Eluaramae is a veil-spirit of the Nualireth Arcane realm, born in the third age from the grief of a sundered choir of stars. It is said to carry the memory of every hush that followed a catastrophe, and its presence steadies those who have stared into ruin.

rites.name: Thethis
rites.text: Thethis is a concept within Nualireth that personifies the moment a future is chosen from many branching possibilities. In the Age of the first sovereign, it was said to wander the groves and growing kingdoms, quietly shelving each outcome that was not taken.
